name: Mealie
description: Recipes, meal plans and shopping lists.
compose:
services:
  mealie:
    image: ghcr.io/mealie-recipes/mealie:latest
    container_name: mealie
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:9000"
    environment:
      TZ: "{TZ}"
      ALLOW_SIGNUP: "false"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/app/data
